baseObservation.meaning: immutable preimage only; Git owns live facts

intent: Make the already-converged ICTC interface visually calm, legible and deliberately enterprise-grade without adding a presentation layer, changing business authority or broadening claims.

copyContract.tone: serious enterprise compliance platform: direct, bounded, operational, non-promotional
copyContract.firstPlane: one concise purpose sentence before work; internal architecture vocabulary stays out of primary copy
copyContract.sentenceRule: prefer verb + governed object + outcome; keep claim boundary separate
copyContract.languageRule: prefer clear Italian business terms over avoidable English implementation terms
copyContract.minimalityRule: remove duplication before shortening meaning; no ellipsis for canonical purpose copy

visualContract.designSystemPolicy: reuse existing tokens and presentation owners; no new CSS layer or component technology
visualContract.badgeAlignment: inline-center with adjacent record title; mobile stacks deliberately

maxYieldMinCost.reason: The dominant residual defects come from inherited truncation, compressed local typography and metadata alignment, not from the palette, tokens or chrome.

mutationCampaigns.purpose: kill typical visual anomalies such as truncation, tiny text, offset badges, overflow and weak hierarchy
search the declared beauty lever space for maximum cognitive yield at minimum change cost
kill beauty-only regressions while preserving semantics, actionability and responsive order

acceptance: 13/13 canonical surfaces remain owned exactly once by the C5 contract
7/7 business procedures remain unchanged as business procedures
Process directory canonical titles and purposes are readable without desktop ellipsis
Canonical procedure purpose text wraps naturally instead of occupying an artificially narrow single line
GRC status badges align with record titles and are readable without forced uppercase or reduced opacity
Proof, Admin, AI settings and dialog secondary text preserve a readable floor
desktop/tablet/mobile geometry preserves actions and avoids horizontal overflow
three deterministic 1,000,000-trial model campaigns complete with zero unexplained survivors
rendered browser beauty check covers all 13 canonical surfaces on desktop and mobile
existing P2/P3A semantic/browser rails remain blocking and unchanged
claimBoundary: P4 can establish repository and rendered-browser evidence for typography, wrapping, alignment, copy shape and responsive geometry. Mutation counts are synthetic model evidence, not three million users or browser sessions. Automated visual rules do not establish representative human pleasantness, accessibility effectiveness, deployment assurance, legal compliance or enterprise readiness; E3-HUMAN remains external.
